review_candidates.title: Principal Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Company Join BAE Systems and become part of a global leader in defense, aerospace, and security solutions. With a rich history of innovation and excellence, BAE Systems is committed to delivering advanced technology-led products and services that safeguard nations and enhance security worldwide. Our diverse portfolio spans from maritime and land systems to aerospace and cyber capabilities, providing our employees with opportunities to work on impactful projects that shape the future. We foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where talent, creativity, and dedication are valued, ensuring that every team member can thrive and contribute meaningfully to our mission of protecting what matters most. About The Role We are seeking a highly skilled Principal Systems Engineer to join our team at Portsmouth Naval Base. This pivotal role is situated within the Systems Engineering Hub, part of the Warship Technical Authority Service Hub, which provides comprehensive support for naval systems and equipment throughout their lifecycle. In this capacity, you will lead and manage complex systems engineering projects, ensuring the delivery of tailored solutions that meet contractual and operational requirements. Your expertise will support the Asset Management Service Hubs, including warship Platform Management, Maintenance Management, Supply Chain, Data, and Digital Services. As a technical authority, you will provide leadership, mentoring, and strategic guidance to engineering teams, fostering innovation and excellence in systems engineering practices. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a degree in a STEM or systems-related discipline, or have equivalent professional experience. You should be actively working towards Chartered Engineer (CEng) status or operating at that level of capability. Proven experience in applying systems engineering principles across the entire lifecycle—including requirements management, architecture definition, integration, and verification & validation—is essential. Familiarity with high-level design methodologies and architectures such as UAF, NAF, TOGAF, SysML, and UML, along with practical skills in MBSE tools like Enterprise Architect, is required. Knowledge of systems engineering standards, particularly ISO 15288, and experience with requirements and interface management tools such as DOORS, will be highly advantageous. Strong leadership capabilities, with the ability to guide and mentor engineering teams, are also essential. Responsibilities As a Principal Systems Engineer, your core responsibilities will include understanding complex problem spaces, defining system architectures, and establishing clear success criteria. You will be responsible for maintaining system interfaces, recording key decisions, and supporting bids and concept studies with robust, evidence-based architectures. Collaborating with stakeholders to capture, decompose, and agree on requirements, you will set acceptance criteria and ensure end-to-end traceability throughout projects. Championing Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), you will set modeling standards, utilize appropriate toolsets, and generate outputs that support design, verification, and compliance activities. You will break down ambiguous, multi-domain problems into manageable, testable elements, defining abstraction levels and interfaces to control scope and visualize dependencies. Tailoring the engineering lifecycle, you will plan progressive integration, prepare teams for design reviews, and drive verification and validation activities to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery. You will also lead systems integration efforts, collaborating with other disciplines within WTA to achieve seamless system performance. Acting as a technical expert, you will lead technical reviews, ensure adherence to safety and security standards, and contribute to assurance and accreditation processes. Furthermore, you will own and deliver multiple concurrent work packages, defining statements of work, managing risks, resolving conflicts, and ensuring technical excellence. Mentoring and coaching engineers, you will promote best practices in systems engineering and support capability development across teams. Your leadership will be instrumental in enhancing the effectiveness and maturity of systems engineering processes within the organization. Benefits At BAE Systems, we are committed to supporting our employees’ growth and well-being. We offer competitive salaries, with this role up to £57,000 depending on skills and experience. Our flexible and hybrid working arrangements enable a healthy work-life balance, tailored to individual needs. Employees benefit from ongoing professional development opportunities, including training and mentoring programs, to help advance their careers. We also provide comprehensive health and wellbeing support, pension schemes, and various employee assistance programs. Our inclusive culture fosters diversity and belonging, ensuring everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. Recognitions, rewards, and opportunities for career progression are integral to our approach, making BAE Systems a place where your skills and dedication are truly appreciated. Equal Opportunity BAE Systems is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances innovation and drives better business outcomes. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to ensure that all individuals have the opportunity to succeed and thrive within our organization.

S pobočkami ve více než 45 zemích a schopností obsloužit zákazníky ve více než 170 zemích spojujeme lokální perspektivu s rozsahem a dodávkami jediné globální organizace. Naše portfolio špičkových výrobců z oblasti IT bezpečnosti je pečlivě vybráno ve spolupráci s předními hráči v odvětví. Naše služby sahají od řízeného zabezpečení až po odborné technické akreditace a školení a využívají rychle se vyvíjející technologie a měnící se obchodní modely. Pro více informací navštivte www.exclusive-networks.com/cz. V Exclusive Networks toužíme něco změnit. Chceme poskytovat našim klientům to nejlepší, přispívat k vytvoření prosperujícího a bezpečného digitálního světa a pomáhat našim lidem realizovat jejich potenciál. POVINNOSTI A ODPOVĚDNOSTI | O pozici Baví vás práce s IT technologiemi a aktivní navazování nových kontaktů? Rád/a naplňujete potřeby partnerů a zákazníků? Máte chuť neustále se posouvat a hledáte vždy nové cesty? Pokud ano, čtěte dál! Vaše pracovní náplň na pozici Sales Support Specialist bude především: Příprava obchodních nabídek pro produkt Fortinet (renewals, trade-ups, follow-ups, obchodní řešení leadů) Spolupráce s celým sales týmem a marketingovým oddělením Zodpovědnost za reporting směrem k výrobci a za sales tým Telefonická komunikace s partnery a zákazníky, budování dlouhodobých vztahů Spolupráce na tvorbě obchodních plánů a marketingových strategií pro svěřené produkty Aktivní spolupráce na přípravě marketingových aktivit, účast a follow-up po marketingových aktivitách Pomoc při zpracování nabídek pro BDM, sales specialisty a při agendě SMB Práce v CRM a dalších systémech KVALIFIKACE A ZKUŠENOSTI | O vás Na Pozici Sales Support Specialist Oceníme Min. SŠ vzdělání s maturitou (ideálně ekonomického směru) Min. 1 rok praxe na obdobné pozici AJ na úrovni min. B1 Proaktivní týmový hráč se základními analytickými schopnostmi Vytrvalost, houževnatost, pečlivost Znalost práce v Excelu Co By Se Vám Ještě Mohlo Hodit orientace na IT a telekomunikačním trhu, znalost partnerského trhu CO NABÍZÍME Naše Benefity příspěvek na stravné školení a certifikace hrazené zaměstnavatelem jazyková výuka Interní systém zaměstnaneckých benefitů (kafeterie) Multisport karta příspěvek na rozvojové vzdělávání dle vlastního výběru Hedepy.cz - program duševního zdraví pro zaměstnance 5 týdnů dovolené/rok cestovní pojištění PRACOVNÍ PODMÍNKY pružná pracovní doba po domluvě možnost práce z domova KDO JSME? | Proč u nás pracovat Jsme zaměřeni na lidi a pevně věříme, že talentovaní profesionálové nám umožňují nadále vybočovat a růst i v budoucnu. Naším posláním je pohánět přechod do zcela důvěryhodného digitálního světa pro všechny lidi a organizace. Navštivte naši webovou stránku www.exclusive-networks.com/cz/. Jsme hrdí na to, že jsme zaměstnavatelem s rovnými příležitostmi. Zavázali jsme se k náboru jednotlivců z různých prostředí a s různými zkušenostmi, protože věříme, že to posiluje naši schopnost vyvíjet vynikající řešení, činit informovaná rozhodnutí a lépe sloužit našim váženým zákazníkům. Nediskriminujeme jednotlivce na základě rasy, náboženství, barvy pleti, národnostního původu, pohlaví, sexuální orientace, zdravotního postižení nebo podobné charakteristiky. Rozhodnutí o zaměstnání jsou činěna výhradně na základě kvalifikace, zásluh a obchodních potřeb. Prosím, pro další informace si přečtěte naši Politiku diverzity a inkluze. Staráme se o vaše údaje: Před odesláním žádosti a sdílením vašich údajů s námi prosím klikněte zde pro přečtení našich Zásad ochrany náborových dat

review_candidates.title: Database Developer
review_candidates.description: ABOUT THE ROLE AagatiServe is looking for experienced Database Developers with deep MS SQL Server expertise in a Windows Server environment. You will write complex and efficient queries, tune database performance, safeguard data through robust backup and recovery practices, and help design high availability and disaster recovery solutions for client engagements. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES •    Design, develop and maintain databases on the latest version of MS SQL Server in a Windows Server environment. •    Write complex yet efficient queries to meet application and reporting requirements. •    Perform performance tuning and optimization (PTO) using native monitoring and troubleshooting tools. •    Plan and manage backups, restores and recovery models to protect data integrity. •    Implement and support High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) options for SQL Server. •    Work with Windows Server, including Active Directory, in support of database environments. •    Collaborate with development, infrastructure and client teams, communicating clearly in writing and verbally. TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES •    Hands-on experience with Windows Server environments and the latest version of MS SQL Server. •    Expertise in writing complex but efficient queries. •    Experience with performance tuning and optimization (PTO) using native monitoring and troubleshooting tools. •    Experience with backups, restores and recovery models. •    Knowledge of High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) options for SQL Server. •    Experience working with Windows Server, including Active Directory. •    Knowledge of MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle or MongoDB (added advantage). EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS •    B.E. / B.Tech, or PG (CS/IT) or equivalent (e.g. MCA). •    Minimum 8 years of total experience, of which at least 5 years should be relevant. •    Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

review_candidates.title: Cloud Platform Engineer for Tech Startup (m/w/d)
review_candidates.description: At Livello, you won't be writing ticket after ticket in a faceless enterprise. You'll be one of the people responsible for our entire cloud platform - the backbone that connects our intelligent retail kiosks to the services that make them work - keeping hundreds of smart kiosks running autonomously across multiple countries. This role is a production infrastructure position with operational responsibility from day one. We are looking for candidates who already have demonstrable hands-on experience operating Linux-based cloud workloads in production, including Kubernetes environments, GCP, messaging systems, deployment automation, and infrastructure troubleshooting. The focus of the role is platform reliability, security, networking, access control, and service operations across our cloud stack. Tasks Operate and improve our Kubernetes-based infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform, keeping production workloads healthy and performant Modernize our authorization and authentication services for better scalability and security Implement and maintain deployment pipelines with a focus on consistency, automation, and reproducibility using tools like Ansible Design inter-service communication patterns that keep our distributed system resilient Cloud security practices including certificate management, access controls, and operational compliance Build internal tooling and management capabilities for cloud components such as messaging systems and databases Develop and maintain redundancy and high-availability strategies as the platform scales Requirements 2+ years of hands-on experience operating Linux-based cloud infrastructure and containerized workloads in production 2+ years of practical Kubernetes experience in production, including networking, rollout management, troubleshooting, and service reliability 2+ years hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform / AWS in production environments, ideally with GKE, IAM, VPC, Cloud DNS, Load Balancing, and observability tooling Proven experience writing and maintaining infrastructure-as-code with Terraform and/or Ansible in production systems Confident understanding of Linux, container networking, DNS, TLS, authentication/authorization concepts, and incident-oriented troubleshooting Ability to take ownership for operational stability, rollout processes, and security-related infrastructure tasks A valid full-time work permit for Germany Benefits Real ownership, early: You won't shadow someone for six months — you'll contribute to production infrastructure from the start Accelerated growth: Direct exposure to architecture decisions, security practices, and scaling challenges that larger companies gate behind years of seniority Modern stack: Kubernetes, GCP, Ansible, containerized microservices — no legacy monoliths Startup culture: An international, open-minded team with flat hierarchies and fast decision-making Creative input: Your ideas on architecture, tooling, and process improvements are welcome and expected Perks: Free EGYM Wellpass membership, dog-friendly office in central Düsseldorf with great food and public transport A valid full-time work permit for Germany is required for this position. Livello develops intelligent, autonomous smart kiosks — fully automated retail stations that independently identify, manage, and sell products. Our mission is to provide people everywhere with fast, convenient access to healthy food and everyday essentials — 24/7, wherever they are. Our vision is to shape the future of Automated Autonomous Retail and bring our technology into every company, hotel, and public building. ED: 12.05.25
